SWIMLANE census (activity-swimlane-rendering; T0 pinned the pre-change model, T7 re-pinned this post-change model on 2026-09-09): for every committed activity fixture whose SOURCE has a swimlane line (CommandSwimlane.java:59-67 needle, never a slug list), records for OURS and for the JAR golden the lane dividers (x, document order), the title band rect, the title texts (font-size / x / text-anchor, document order), the per-lane extents (ours from ActivityGeometry.swimlanes; jar from consecutive ascending dividers), and the root canvas -- plus laneCount from our AST. Measured by tests/oracle/svg-conformance/swimlane-census.ts through the same seams the ratchet uses. Partition 60 baseline / 24 error / 8 jar-error of 92. After T6 ours draws n+1 dividers per multi-lane fixture (both outer edges, Swimlanes.java:327), a transparent band (fill=none, plantuml.skin:310 / Swimlanes.java:357-367) of the MEASURED title height (AtomText.java:179-181 floor of 10), titles centred over the lane content with no text-anchor (UGraphicCompressOnXorY.java:100-112) and drawn LAST (D5), and nothing at all for a single lane (Swimlanes.java:253,275). Equality pin, not a ratchet; never hand-edit. RE-PINNED by activity-min-box-width T6 (2026-09-09): lane extents and canvases moved on the 57 multi-lane fixtures because the 120px action-box floor no longer widens lane content; dividers/titles/bands are unchanged in count (ours 195/138/57, jar 195/139/57).
